FAQ

Does shipping trail condition reports auto-translate my China listing?

No. Trail condition data feeds, park closure APIs, and in-app status badges control device behavior — they do not create or fill a Simplified Chinese localization row. Empty or English zh-Hans fields mean China buyers see en-US fallback.

What listing fields does AppLocale rewrite for Trail Conditions apps?

Paste-ready Simplified Chinese (zh-Hans) copy for App Store Connect listing fields you specify: title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text when included, and screenshot overlay or caption lines — rewritten from your English Trail Conditions marketing originals.

Can AppLocale implement trail condition APIs or park-service data feeds?

No. We deliver listing metadata copy only. Trail condition feed engineering, closure API wiring, and sample trail status asset design are outside AppLocale scope.

How is this different from Backtrack, Hiking Elevation, Topographic Maps, or Offline Maps?

Trail Conditions copy markets current trail surface and status — mud, snow, ice, closures, 步道状况, 泥泞路况, 积雪覆盖, 步道关闭. Backtrack copy markets breadcrumb path retrace — 返回路径. Hiking Elevation copy markets elevation gain charts — 徒步爬升. Topographic Maps copy markets contour map layers — 地形图, 等高线. Offline Maps copy markets download offline map areas — 离线地图. Each surface has separate screenshot vocabulary.
